{"search_note":"I did **not** find strong 2024 Biden-specific evidence on:
- domestic biological-risk policy beyond chem-bio AI oversight,
- direct AI frontier-model regulation outside safety institutes and NIST guidance,
- or a single comprehensive cross-domain existential-risk strategy.

So the overall call is **inferential**: safer in the aggregate, with real escalation tradeoffs and incomplete coverage outside nuclear/AI/cyber.","evidence":[{"title":"Biden-Harris Administration Announces First-Ever Consortium Dedicated to AI Safety","publisher":"NIST","date":"2024-02-08","url":"https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2024/02/biden-harris-administration-announces-first-ever-consortium-dedicated-ai","summary":"The administration created the U.S. AI Safety Institute Consortium with 200+ stakeholders and tied it to red-teaming, capability evaluations, risk management, and watermarking. This is clear evidence of safer AI governance than a laissez-faire baseline.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.9","1B.7"]},{"title":"U.S. Secretary of Commerce Gina Raimondo Releases Strategic Vision on AI Safety, Announces Plan for Global Cooperation Among AI Safety Institutes","publisher":"NIST","date":"2024-05-21","url":"https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2024/05/us-secretary-commerce-gina-raimondo-releases-strategic-vision-ai-safety","summary":"NIST’s AI Safety Institute was launched at Biden’s direction to advance the science of AI safety through scientific cooperation and testing/validation. This strengthens the country’s catastrophic-risk posture in a domain that did not have this institutional scaffolding at the start of the term.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.9","1B.7"]},{"title":"NIST Launches ARIA, a New Program to Advance Sociotechnical Testing and Evaluation for AI","publisher":"NIST","date":"2024-05-28","url":"https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2024/05/nist-launches-aria-new-program-advance-sociotechnical-testing-and","summary":"ARIA was launched to improve testing, evaluation, validation, and verification of AI systems in realistic settings. That is precautionary institutional capacity for a major emerging-risk domain.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.9"]},{"title":"U.S. AI Safety Institute Issues Request for Information Related to Responsible Development and Use of Chem-Bio AI Models","publisher":"NIST","date":"2024-10-04","url":"https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2024/10/us-ai-safety-institute-issues-request-information-related-responsible","summary":"The AI Safety Institute sought expert input on chem-bio AI risks and mitigation approaches. That is direct precaution in one of the clearest catastrophic-risk domains.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.9"]},{"title":"Statement by the United States on the Twentieth Anniversary of UNSCR 1540","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"2024-04-29","url":"https://2021-2025.state.gov/statement-by-the-united-states-on-the-twentieth-anniversary-of-unscr-1540/","summary":"The U.S. treated UNSCR 1540 as a central anti-proliferation tool and urged tight controls on sensitive WMD-related goods and know-how. That is disciplined command-and-control architecture, which makes the posture safer than an improvised one.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.3","1B.5","1B.7","1B.8"]},{"title":"Joint Statement on the U.S.-ROK Nuclear Consultative Group Simulation","publisher":"U.S. Department of Defense","date":"2024-09-06","url":"https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/3898151/joint-statement-on-the-us-rok-nuclear-consultative-group-simulation/","summary":"The first NCG simulation rehearsed decision-making across defense, diplomatic, military, and intelligence channels. This weakens a pure “safer” reading, though it is still a conventional-war decision rather than a direct existential-risk-policy failure.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.8","1B.5"]},{"title":"Biden allows Ukraine to use U.S.-supplied weapons in strikes near Kharkiv","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-05-30","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/biden-allows-ukraine-to-use-ussupplied-arms-to-strike-inside-russia-near-kharkiv-area-say-us-officials-3464558","summary":"Biden loosened restrictions on U.S.-supplied weapons near Kharkiv, which deliberately widened the escalation envelope. This is the clearest 2024 “more dangerous” signal I found, but it is still tied to a defensive war.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.8","1B.5"]}]}
